description: SF4 (bean qou-y7ey, epic qou-a3n3): tests the SF-arc's named fidelity caveat — DN has no backscatter — by rerunning the SF3 protocol in a GOY-class shell model (complex amplitudes, all-conjugated three-shell interactions, (a,b,c)=(1,-delta,delta-1), a+b+c=0, with exact energy conservation on the q-integer ladder, verified analytically: all triad (m,m+1,m+2) terms share the factor k_m, so conservation is ladder-independent). Unforced Kolmogorov load, viscous-scaled horizon, classical same-nu controls; N-sweep at delta=1/2 plus delta-sweep at N=16. If survival grows with N or R=S_q/S_cl >> 1, backward transfer re-opens the unforced sustained channel and the DN-based closure was a model artifact; if flat with R ~ 1, the regularity picture survives its own caveat and sustained forcing remains the only in-model blow-up channel. Scope (a); exploratory tier; float64 RK2.
